header.title: Terms & Conditions
header.subtitle: Platform Scope, Competitions & Disclaimers
header.description: Please read these terms carefully before using our platform. By participating in our competitions, you agree to these terms.

sections.title: Platform Scope & Role
paragraphs: The platform operates exclusively as an online trading competition, performance-ranking, marketing, and referral platform.
items: brokerage services
investment or financial services
proprietary trading
portfolio or asset management
capital allocation
investment or trading advisory services
sections.footer: The platform does not execute trades, influence trading decisions, or manage trading activity in any form.

sections.title: Broker Partnership & No Client Funds
paragraphs: The platform operates in partnership with FpTrading, a globally regulated brokerage provider.
All trading activity and participant capital remain entirely and exclusively with FpTrading at all times.
items: does not receive, hold, manage, safeguard, or control participant funds
does not access trading accounts
does not process deposits or withdrawals
sections.footer: The platform acts solely as a competition and performance-ranking interface and does not intervene in broker operations.

sections.title: Trading Activity & Participant Responsibility
paragraphs: Participants trade independently through accounts held with FpTrading.

items: opening and maintaining their trading accounts with FpTrading
complying with FpTrading's terms, rules, and applicable regulations
all trading decisions and risk management

paragraphs: Participants are required to comply with both, LTL Platform Terms & Conditions and all applicable terms, conditions, policies, rules, procedures, and regulatory requirements of FpTrading governing their trading account and trading activity.
https://www.fptrading.com/faq/
By participating in a competition, participants acknowledge that their trading account and trading activity remain subject to FpTrading's applicable terms and conditions at all times.

Any breach of FpTrading's terms, conditions, policies, rules, or applicable requirements may result in the participant being deemed ineligible or disqualified from the competition where such breach affects the participant's eligibility or the integrity of the competition.

subsections.introText: The platform has no control, ownership, or responsibility over:
items: trade execution
pricing
spreads
leverage
margin requirements
order handling
account balances

sections.title: Competitions & Platform Purpose
paragraphs: Competitions hosted on the platform are designed solely for skill-based performance comparison, engagement, and entertainment purposes.
items: investment products
trading services
financial instruments
profit-sharing schemes
offers to invest or participate in any investment opportunity
additionalParagraphs: All rankings and displayed statistics are used exclusively for competitive evaluation and do not represent investment performance.
Competition registration remains open until three (3) calendar days prior to the official competition end date. Once registration is closed, no additional participants may enter the competition.

The company reserves the right to modify, suspend, postpone, or cancel a competition where reasonably necessary, including in circumstances involving technical issues, broker-related disruptions, regulatory requirements, force majeure events, suspected manipulation, fraud, or other circumstances affecting the integrity or proper operation of the competition.

sections.title: Performance Ranking & Winner Determination
paragraphs: Competition rankings are determined exclusively based on the percentage return (ROI) achieved during the competition period, as reflected on the competition ranking page.
Rankings are calculated based on the highest percentage return achieved by participants, regardless of the amount of capital deposited.

clarifications.title: Key clarifications:
items: Account size, leverage, or initial deposit amount do not affect ranking position
Rankings are calculated purely on percentage performance
Percentage results are used solely for competition ranking purposes

sections.footer: In the event of a tie, the company may apply a predetermined tie-breaking method communicated on the relevant competition page.

sections.title: Performance Calculation, Account Rules & Disqualification
paragraphs: Percentage performance is calculated using the participant's initial deposit amount at the start of the competition period as the fixed baseline reference.

subsections.title: Account Rules:
items: Additional deposits into the same trading account are not permitted unless the account's trading positions have been closed due to insufficient margin
Each trading account participates in the competition based on its active deposit balance

Participants may not use multiple accounts to circumvent competition rules or obtain an unfair competitive advantage unless multiple-account participation is expressly permitted for the relevant competition

subsections.title: Disqualification:
paragraphs: A participant's trading account is considered to have lost the competition and is automatically disqualified from ranking when all open positions are closed by the broker due to insufficient margin, margin stop-out, or forced liquidation.

The company reserves the right to disqualify any participant where there is reasonable evidence of fraud, manipulation, exploitation of technical errors, falsification of information, abuse of the competition rules, or other conduct that compromises the fairness or integrity of the competition.

subsections.title: Re-Entry & Redeposit Conditions:
paragraphs: If a participant's positions are closed due to insufficient margin, the participant may redeposit funds into the same trading account and continue participating in the same competition, subject to the conditions below.
items: The participant's competition performance resets to 0% ROI
Any losses, results, or performance from the previous trading cycle do not influence or affect the new deposit
The redeposit is treated as a new competition entry for ranking purposes

paragraphs: Redeposits are allowed only while competition registration remains open.

sections.title: Rewards & Prizes
sections.introText: Any rewards, prizes, or incentives offered through competitions are:
items: fixed and predefined
not derived from pooled participant trading capital
not based on profit sharing or capital allocation
additionalParagraphs: All prizes will be credited directly to the winners' trading accounts held with FpTrading.

items: is performed by the broker
is subject to the broker's standard processing timelines and account conditions
does not involve the platform holding or transferring participant funds

sections.footer: The company does not guarantee the timing of prize crediting where processing is dependent on FpTrading or other third parties.

sections.title: Conditions of Participation
sections.introText: To be eligible for participation in any competition, participants must:
items: Open a trading account with FpTrading using the referral code displayed on the competition page or by clicking the official competition registration link
Have a minimum account balance equal to or greater than the "Minimum Deposit Required" specified for the selected competition

subsections.title: The Minimum Deposit Required:
items: is displayed on the individual competition page
may vary depending on the specific competition
must be met for each trading account used to participate

additionalParagraphs: Participation may also be subject to geographic, age, eligibility, and regulatory restrictions applicable to the participant or the relevant competition.
sections.footer: Failure to meet these conditions may result in ineligibility or exclusion from the competition.

sections.title: Public Leaderboard & Name Display
paragraphs: Participant names will be publicly displayed on the platform's competition leaderboard for the purpose of ranking visibility and performance comparison.

By entering a competition, participants expressly consent to the public display of their name on the competition ranking page, allowing all participants to view relative positioning and performance throughout the competition period.
sections.footer: The public display of participant names is limited strictly to competition ranking and transparency purposes and does not constitute marketing, endorsement, or performance promotion.

sections.title: No Investment Advice Disclaimer
sections.introText: All content, rankings, statistics, competition results, and information provided on the platform:
items: are for informational and entertainment purposes only
do not constitute investment advice, trading advice, or financial recommendations
sections.footer: Participants trade entirely at their own risk and discretion.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.introText: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the company shall not be liable for:
items: trading losses
broker actions or failures
execution quality
account performance
margin calls, liquidation, or financial outcomes resulting from participant trading activity
delays, interruptions, or technical failures affecting the platform or competition
inaccurate, delayed, or unavailable market or account data supplied by third parties
failure by FpTrading or any other third party to process deposits, withdrawals, prizes, or other transactions
sections.footer: Nothing in these Terms & Conditions excludes or limits liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited under applicable law.

sections.title: Competition Data & Technical Accuracy
paragraphs: Competition rankings and performance statistics may rely on data received from FpTrading or other third-party systems.

While the company will take reasonable measures to maintain accurate competition data, the company does not guarantee that all data will always be complete, uninterrupted, instantaneous, or error-free.

Where a technical error, data discrepancy, or system malfunction materially affects competition rankings, the company reserves the right to investigate and, where reasonably necessary, correct rankings, suspend affected results, or take other measures necessary to preserve the integrity of the competition.

sections.title: Changes to Competition Rules & FpTrading Terms
paragraphs: Competition-specific rules, prize structures, eligibility requirements, minimum deposits, registration deadlines, and other conditions may vary between competitions.
The rules applicable to a particular competition will be displayed on the relevant competition page.
items: these Platform Terms & Conditions
the specific rules applicable to the relevant competition
all applicable terms, conditions, policies, rules, procedures, and requirements imposed by FpTrading in connection with their trading account and trading activity
additionalParagraphs: By entering a competition, participants agree to comply with both these Terms & Conditions and any competition-specific rules published for that competition.

In the event of a conflict between these Platform Terms & Conditions and FpTrading's terms and conditions regarding the operation, maintenance, regulation, or use of the participant's trading account, FpTrading's applicable terms and conditions shall govern matters relating to the participant's trading account and trading activity.
Participants are responsible for reviewing and understanding FpTrading's applicable terms and conditions before opening or using their trading account.

sections.title: Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
paragraphs: These Terms & Conditions shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws applicable to the company's jurisdiction.

Any dispute arising out of or relating to these Terms & Conditions or participation in a competition shall be subject to the jurisdiction specified by the company in its applicable legal and corporate documentation.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By registering for or participating in any competition, the participant confirms that they have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions, the applicable competition-specific rules, and the applicable terms and conditions of FpTrading.

If a participant does not agree to these Terms & Conditions, the applicable competition rules, or FpTrading's applicable terms and conditions, they must not register for or participate in any competition.
